title: AI时代年轻人的11条反常识
series: 孙宇晨×邵艾伦 4小时对谈精华

source.author: 孙可可 @Sunkeke_AI
source.article: 孙宇晨×邵艾伦爆火对谈：年轻人如何抓住 AI 时代的机会？（原稿精华整理版）

imageStyle: cinematic digital illustration, editorial magazine cover art, deep navy and charcoal background with warm amber and electric cyan rim light, volumetric light, soft film grain, rich detail, vertical composition with clear empty space in the upper third, absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark

headline: 4小时对谈
11条反常识

images.prompt: a young person sitting on a rainy city rooftop at night holding a glowing smartphone, holographic AI data streams and floating screens rising from the phone into the sky, a glowing digital globe, skyline of a huge Chinese city

lines: 孙宇晨和邵艾伦聊了整整4个小时
我把最反常识的11条结论
压缩成这3分钟，建议先收藏

headline: 重回20岁
怎么重新开始？
scenes.quote: 孙学升级大脑，薄肌升级身体，黄毛升级心态。

images.prompt: a lone twenty-year-old standing at a crossroads of glowing paths at dusk, holding only a phone and a few banknotes, many roads branching into fog, sense of uncertainty and possibility

a translucent human silhouette as an upgraded operating system: glowing brain circuitry, lean athletic body outlined in light, and a calm confident aura, with a small AI core orb steering like a ship's helm

lines: 如果重新回到20岁
没人脉、没资源，每月只有1000块
该怎么重新开始？
孙宇晨给的答案，是一套人生操作系统
孙学升级大脑，薄肌升级身体
黄毛思维升级心态，再让AI来掌舵

headline: 第一件事
先把自己AI化
scenes.quote: 可视化、数据化、可总结化，然后全部搞成Markdown文档。

images.prompt: close-up of hands holding a smartphone, the screen projecting holographic charts of meals, workouts, sleep and heart rate, a cozy small rented room at night

a glowing stack of neatly organized document files stored inside a personal vault on a desk, several different AI robot heads lined up as interchangeable plug-in processors connecting to the vault with cables

lines: 第一条，先把自己AI化
只有一部手机也够了，很多AI都能免费用
把饮食、训练、睡眠全部记录下来
可视化、数据化，存成Markdown文档
数据握在自己手里，模型随时可以换

headline: 别急着要答案
先让AI了解你
scenes.quote: 先积累个2到4个月，把所有的数据都收集齐。

images.prompt: a calendar wall of many days filled with small glowing data cards, a young person pinning one more card each day, patient long-term record keeping
a glowing external brain made of light floating beside a young person's head, connected by thin fibers, like a personal AI co-pilot that knows them well

lines: 第二条，别急着让AI给答案
先连续记录2到4个月的真实数据
没有数据，AI只是个博学的陌生人
有了数据，它才是你的外接大脑
但最后拍板的，永远是现实结果

headline: 别太早
确定方向
scenes.quote: 你就先用它把整个地图探一遍，再做决定。

images.prompt: a young person walking through a long corridor of a hundred different glowing apartment doors and floor plans, only looking, taking notes, not buying
a strategy-game style fog-of-war map seen from above, a drone scout revealing glowing resource markers across dark territory, a small base in the corner

lines: 第三条，别太早确定方向
想买房，先看100套，只看不买
选专业、选行业，先让AI帮你探遍地图
很多人用十年的努力
弥补开始时十天的信息不足

headline: 别追赛道
找价值断点
scenes.quote: 商业首先最基本的，就是看你有没有创造价值。

images.prompt: two glowing cliffs separated by a chasm, on one side crowds holding goods, on the other side crowds waiting with needs, a single broken bridge between them
a builder connecting the two ends of a broken glowing bridge with a bright beam of light, goods and coins starting to flow across

lines: 第四条，别问哪个赛道最赚钱
要找价值断点
有供给有需求，却没连上
有数据没人处理，有知识没变成产品
把断开的两端接起来，收入只是结果

headline: 内卷？
是计量单位太小
scenes.quote: 把全世界的人当做你的客户。

images.prompt: a tiny crowded fish tank packed with fish competing, placed in front of a window that shows a vast open ocean
a glowing earth seen from orbit with luminous trade routes and shipping lanes connecting continents, a young person standing on the horizon looking at it

lines: 第五条，内卷可能是计量单位太小
商机一定要全球性发现
面对八十亿人的需求
机会就是另一个数量级

headline: 先自由
后财富
scenes.quote: 哪里有水，哪里有草，我们就去哪住。

images.prompt: a nomad with a light backpack walking across a vast grassland toward a distant river at sunrise, free and mobile, minimalist
a heavy iron chain shaped like a mortgage contract attached to a house anchoring a person in place, contrasted with a portable glowing backpack containing a laptop, tools, and trophies

lines: 第六条，先自由，后财富
财富只是自由的伴生品
别太早用高额房贷把自己锁死
多攒能带走的资产：作品、能力、客户信任

headline: AI越强
身体越值钱
scenes.quote: 肌肉相当于是身体里最重要的银行账户。

images.prompt: a lean athletic young person doing a deadlift in a dark gym lit by amber light, muscles subtly glowing like gold coins in a vault, healthy and strong but not bulky
a human figure made of warm carbon-like glowing fibers acting as a server rack, surrounded by dozens of small silicon AI robots working at desks, all powered by the human

lines: 第七条，AI越强，身体越值钱
AI时代什么都会变便宜，唯一值钱的是寿命
肌肉是身体里最重要的银行账户
AI是硅基团队，身体是碳基服务器
别让服务器提前宕机

headline: 黄毛思维
+ Small Ego
scenes.quote: 有新的就得学，有新的就得干。

images.prompt: a young person with bright bleached yellow hair walking forward confidently against a strong wind made of swirling speech bubbles and doubt symbols
a successful mentor and a young apprentice sitting together on equal footing at a workbench, the mentor listening carefully and taking notes, warm humble atmosphere

lines: 第八条，黄毛思维加Small Ego
认定对的事，不怕质疑，充分执行
但再成功，也愿意听年轻人讲
没新证据就坚持，证明错了马上改

headline: 机器
怎么使用钱？
scenes.quote: 把人类几千年的货币，翻译成AI和机器听得懂的语言。
scenes.disclaimer: 嘉宾个人观点，不构成任何投资建议

images.prompt: ancient coins and paper money transforming into streams of glowing code and digital tokens as they pass through a translation prism
small autonomous AI robot agents trading with each other in a futuristic marketplace, exchanging glowing tokens for data cubes and GPU chips

lines: 第九条，Crypto要解决的
是机器怎么使用钱
当AI智能体要买数据、租算力、彼此结算
它需要一套机器能直接调用的支付系统

headline: 经验不被AI读取
就等于不存在
scenes.quote: 没有成为AI语料的东西，就像从来没有发生过。

images.prompt: an old master craftsman in a workshop whose memories float above his head as fading translucent images, slowly dissolving into dust
a young librarian carefully scanning handwritten notebooks into a glowing structured knowledge library of crystal shelves

lines: 第十条，不能被AI读取的经验
很容易等于不存在
整理知识库，把流程和案例结构化
这是普通人能切入的基础工作

headline: 体验
大于结论
scenes.quote: 多创造，少消费，然后你做什么基本上都是对的。

images.prompt: a young explorer stepping into a vast colorful open world landscape with floating islands, like a player starting a new game on planet earth
a young maker at a workbench creating things: writing, building a small device, painting, with finished creations glowing on shelves behind

lines: 第十一条，体验大于结论
先参与、先探索，别急着想清人生意义
多创造，少消费
你做什么，基本上都是对的

headline: 别用旧地图
找新大陆

images.prompt: a young explorer on the bow of a ship at dawn holding an old torn paper map that is glowing and transforming into a holographic digital map, a new continent with light appearing on the horizon

lines: 20岁没人脉、没资源并不可怕
可怕的是，世界已经变了
你还在用旧地图找新大陆
这11条你最认同哪一条？评论区聊聊
